title: RuntimeFeatureForbiddenLabelFirewallConfigV1
description: WP-10.5 (Issue #83): structural shape of the runtime-feature/forbidden-label firewall configuration consumed by tools/dataset/feature_firewall.py. This is repository tooling configuration, not part of the I-20 DatasetManifest contract itself.

status.description: ACTIVE for the reviewed runtime and forbidden inventories. TEMPLATE_PENDING_REVIEW remains available only for unresolved replacement documents; tools/dataset/feature_firewall.py refuses non-ACTIVE or placeholder-bearing configurations.

runtime_allowed_features.description: Feature names genuinely available to the on-device model at inference time (e.g. names derived from I-01 RawSensorSample / I-02 GNSS fix style live signals). Anything not on this list is denied by default -- deny-by-default, not deny-by-exception.

forbidden_labels.description: Collision-safe `<schema_id>.<interpreted_field>` IDs for vehicle/reference fields that must never reach runtime tensors, normalization, preprocessing, post-processing, or display smoothing. Checked even if absent from runtime_allowed_features, as defense in depth.
